# Pattern: Enum + Interface with per-value Setup (`ISetupProvider`)

Use this pattern whenever an **extensible enum is paired with an interface** and **one or
more enum values need their own configuration/setup** (different fields per value). It keeps
each value's setup self-contained while the host record only stores a single `Guid`.

Reference implementation in `te365`:
- Interface: `app/Src/Utility/TREBISetupProvider.Interface.al`
- Default provider: `app/Src/Utility/TREBDefaultSetupProvider.Codeunit.al`
- Example enum: `app/Src/AddressValidation/TREBAddrValidationProvider.Enum.al`
- Example value impl: `app/Src/AddressValidation/AzureMapsImplementation/TREBAzureMapsAddrValidator.Codeunit.al`
- Example consumers: `app/Src/Setup/TREBSetup.Page.al`, `TREBContactTemplateSteps.Page.al`

## When to apply
- A feature enum is `Extensible = true` and resolved to behaviour through a feature interface
  (e.g. `IAddressValidator`, `IContactTemplateActionRunner`, `IStagingStepHandler`).
- Individual enum values need persisted configuration before they can run.
- Not every value needs setup — values without setup fall back to a no-op default.

## Building blocks

### 1. The `ISetupProvider` interface (one per feature area, reuse `TREB ISetupProvider` if it fits)
```al
interface "<Prefix> ISetupProvider"
{
    procedure HasSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid): Boolean;
    procedure EditSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid);
    procedure DeleteSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid): Boolean;
}
```

### 2. A default (no-op) provider used as `DefaultImplementation`
```al
codeunit <id> "<Prefix> Default Setup Provider" implements "<Prefix> ISetupProvider"
{
    procedure HasSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid): Boolean
    begin
        exit(false);
    end;

    procedure EditSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid)
    var
        NoSetupErrorLbl: Label 'Not implemented.';
    begin
        Error(ErrorInfo.Create(NoSetupErrorLbl));
    end;

    procedure DeleteSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid): Boolean
    begin
        exit(false);
    end;
}
```

### 3. The feature enum implements BOTH interfaces and declares the default
```al
enum <id> "<Prefix> Addr. Validation Provider" implements "<Prefix> IAddressValidator", "<Prefix> ISetupProvider"
{
    Extensible = true;
    DefaultImplementation = "<Prefix> ISetupProvider" = "<Prefix> Default Setup Provider";

    value(0; AzureMaps)
    {
        Caption = 'Azure Maps';
        Implementation = "<Prefix> IAddressValidator" = "<Prefix> Azure Maps Addr.Validator",
                         "<Prefix> ISetupProvider" = "<Prefix> Azure Maps Addr.Validator";
    }
}
```
- Values that need setup point their `ISetupProvider` implementation at the **same codeunit**
  that implements the feature interface (one codeunit implements both).
- Values that need NO setup simply omit the `ISetupProvider` mapping and inherit the default.

### 4. Each setup-requiring value: one setup Table + one setup Page
- Table: keyed by a single `Guid` id field (e.g. `ID`/`Setup Id`), `Access = Internal`,
  `DataClassification = CustomerContent`.
- Page: `PageType = StandardDialog`, edits that table.

### 5. The implementing codeunit implements both interfaces
```al
codeunit <id> "<Prefix> Azure Maps Addr.Validator" implements "<Prefix> IAddressValidator", "<Prefix> ISetupProvider"
{
    Access = Internal;

    // ... feature interface methods read the setup record via the passed setup Guid ...

    procedure HasSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid): Boolean
    var
        Setup: Record "<Prefix> Azure Maps Setup";
    begin
        exit(Setup.Get(SourceSystemId));
    end;

    procedure EditSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid)
    var
        Setup: Record "<Prefix> Azure Maps Setup";
    begin
        if not Setup.Get(SourceSystemId) then begin
            Setup.Init();
            Setup.ID := SourceSystemId;   // the Guid PK field
            Setup.Insert();
            Commit();                      // commit before RunModal
        end;
        Page.RunModal(Page::"<Prefix> Addr. Azure Maps Setup", Setup);
    end;

    procedure DeleteSetup(SourceSystemId: Guid): Boolean
    var
        Setup: Record "<Prefix> Azure Maps Setup";
    begin
        if Setup.Get(SourceSystemId) then
            exit(Setup.Delete(true));
    end;
}
```

### 6. Host record stores the setup Guid
The record that owns the selected enum value also stores a `Guid` field, e.g.
`"Addr. Validation Setup Guid"` / `"Step Setup Guid"` / `"Env. Det. Setup Guid"`.
This Guid is the `SourceSystemId` passed to all three procedures.

## Consumption (call sites)
Resolve the enum to the **feature** interface, then narrow to `ISetupProvider` defensively
with `is` / `as` (so non-configurable values are handled cleanly):
```al
var
    ActionRunner: Interface "<Prefix> IContactTemplateActionRunner";
begin
    ActionRunner := Rec.Action;                 // enum -> feature interface
    if ActionRunner is "<Prefix> ISetupProvider" then
        SetupTxt := (ActionRunner as "<Prefix> ISetupProvider").HasSetup(Rec."Step Setup Guid") ? ConfiguredLbl : NotConfLbl
    else
        SetupTxt := NotReqLbl;
end;
```
- Edit (e.g. page field `OnDrillDown`): `(X as "<Prefix> ISetupProvider").EditSetup(Rec."... Setup Guid")` — `CurrPage.SaveRecord()` before, `CurrPage.Update()` after.
- Delete (table `OnDelete` / value change triggers): guard with `is` then `DeleteSetup(Rec."... Setup Guid")` to clean up orphaned setup records.

## Checklist when implementing
1. Reuse an existing `ISetupProvider` interface if one fits; otherwise create one with the three procedures.
2. Provide/point to a no-op `Default Setup Provider` and set it as `DefaultImplementation` on the enum.
3. Enum `Extensible = true`, implements feature interface **and** `ISetupProvider`.
4. For each value needing setup: create setup Table (Guid PK) + StandardDialog Page, and have the value's codeunit implement both interfaces.
5. Implement `HasSetup` (= `Setup.Get`), `EditSetup` (lazy `Init`/`Insert`/`Commit` then `Page.RunModal`), `DeleteSetup` (= `Setup.Delete(true)`).
6. Add a `Guid` setup field on the host record and pass it as `SourceSystemId`.
7. Call sites use `is`/`as` narrowing; delete setup on record/value removal to avoid orphans.
8. Apply the `mandatoryPrefix` from `AppSourceCop.json` to every new object and field.
